title: The Station Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: The Station is a 4 BR / 5 BA / 12 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Vast, luxurious, and enjoyable describe The Station cottage and we think you’ll feel the same way once you’ve experienced it.
description_expanded: Description31 SMOLIAN CIRCLE4 KINGS, 2 TWINS, 1 BUNK BEDNew kitchen and bathroom renovations are scheduled to be completed Summer 2026. Updated photos to follow!A Spacious Seaside Retreat Surrounded by Natural BeautyThe Station is a timeless Seaside cottage where generous living spaces, refined comfort, and relaxed coastal living come together effortlessly. Tucked beneath towering shade trees and framed by a classic white picket fence, this three-story vacation home offers a peaceful setting just moments from the best of Seaside, Florida.From the moment you arrive, The Station’s charming architecture sets the tone. Each level features its own furnished balcony, creating multiple outdoor spaces to enjoy Florida’s sunshine, coastal breezes, and quiet moments throughout the day.Inviting First Floor Living & Entertaining SpacesThe first floor welcomes guests into a warm, thoughtfully designed gathering space that blends comfort and style. The open living area, dining room, and fully equipped kitchen serve as the heart of the home, accented by elegant fixtures and Seaside-inspired artwork. Whether you’re preparing a family meal, enjoying conversation by the fireplace, or relaxing after a beach day, this level is designed for connection and ease.Step outside to the front or side porch for additional outdoor living, or take advantage of the conveniently located half bath. Also on this level is one of two spacious primary suites, complete with a private ensuite bathroom and direct access to a furnished porch — a perfect private retreat.Second Floor Bedrooms & Cozy Lounge AreaThe second floor offers a comfortable secondary living space with a TV, ideal for movie nights or quiet downtime. Three beautifully appointed bedrooms are located on this level, including a second primary suite, a king bedroom, and a twin bedroom. Each bedroom features its own private ensuite bathroom, ensuring comfort and privacy for all guests.Just steps away, the second-floor balconies invite you to step outside, unwind, and enjoy the peaceful Seaside surroundings.Third-Floor Tower with Panoramic Seaside ViewsAt the top of the home, the third-floor tower delivers a true Seaside highlight. This elevated retreat offers sweeping views across the community, paired with a relaxing swing that makes it the perfect spot to start your morning with coffee or wind down at sunset with a cocktail. It’s an ideal vantage point to soak in the charm and beauty of Seaside from above.Prime Location Near the Beach, Pools & Downtown SeasideWith four bedrooms and four-and-a-half baths, The Station comfortably accommodates families and groups while offering a layout that balances shared spaces with private retreats. Ideally located just minutes from the West Side pool, Seaside’s private beaches, and the vibrant downtown area, this cottage places you close to shopping, dining, and entertainment while maintaining a tranquil residential feel.The Station invites you to experience Seaside living at its finest — spacious, stylish, and perfectly situated for an unforgettable coastal getaway.* 5 night minimum in Spring, Spring Break, and Summer; 3 night minimum for Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES3,512 square feet of spacious, thoughtfully designed livingSeaside Private Residential Beach access at West Ruskin Pavilion2-minute, 436-foot walk to beach accessAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWasher and dryer on-site for added conveniencePeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homePole-mounted grill on-site for outdoor cookingWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-002006
